purpose: Preserve an authenticated, completed unbound stop when startup expires after kernel read completion.

fieldTrigger.limit: EOF establishes loss before exact receipt delivery, not the precise child branch. The completed-read cancellation race is locally reproduced; its contribution to this field failure requires paired acceptance.

mechanism.before: Bootstrap startup used a context callback that closed the entire duplex control pipe. A completed bootstrap read could lose its retirement response to late startup cancellation. Retirement also rejected an already consumed stop solely because startup.Err became non-nil.
mechanism.after: After successful authentication, the prepared path disarms and memoizes the pipe-close callback before a context-aware native bootstrap read. Cancellation drains only that exact read. A fully consumed reserved zero frame may retire after startup expiry if callback ownership is retained.
mechanism.authority: Real leases retain startup.Err, service proof, lease freshness and exact image checks before activation. Partial, missing or already cancelled bootstraps cannot enter retirement.
mechanism.retirement: Both native exits and the exact existing retirement frame remain required; the independent five-second cleanup deadline and recovery fence remain. No retry, cached authority or new success frame is introduced.

validation.before: TestUnboundRetirementHonorsCompletedStopAfterStartupExpires FAILED on g454: context canceled, native retirement callback never called.
validation.focusedAfter: PASS: UnboundRetirement, PreparedBootstrap, PreparedStop, CancelledPreparedRead and native completed-read regressions (0.160s before full package run).
validation.nativePipe: Real Windows named-pipe tests verify completed zero bootstrap survives cancellation, cancelled reads retain duplex transport, and written receipts survive client close before service read.
validation.negativeCases: Already cancelled startup, running close callback, partial stop, EOF, failed native cleanup, lost receipt, expired retirement budget and unknown exit stay rejected.
